'''Dilvin Lormurojo''' was an [[Author/Legends|author]] that resided in [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Dilvin was the author of an enlightening poem named ''[[Borvo's Other Nose]]'', which criticized the [[Borvo|famouse crimelord's]] wardrobe and general taste.
